# JALTech

> JALTech is a software house specializing in FMCG (fast-moving consumer goods). We build custom internal software, Android sales apps connected to inventory, distributor portals and consumer campaign platforms, and we deliver mall stalls and interactive brand activations.

Clients include Almarai, Puteri and 4G Capital. Contact: comm@ibjects.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://jaltech.org/): FMCG solutions, software services, brand activations, engagement models and FAQs
- [Privacy Policy](https://jaltech.org/privacy.html): How JALTech collects, uses and protects personal data (Saudi PDPL aligned)

## Services

- [Consumer Promotions](https://jaltech.org/#consumer-promotions): Scan-and-win, loyalty and campaign platforms
- [Internal Sales & Inventory Apps](https://jaltech.org/#field-sales): Custom Android apps for sales teams connected to inventory
- [Custom Internal Solutions](https://jaltech.org/#enterprise-software): HR, finance, operations, approvals and MIT apps
- [Brand Activations](https://jaltech.org/#brand-activations): Mall stalls, pop-ups and interactive consumer experiences
- [Mobile App Development](https://jaltech.org/#mobile-apps): iOS, Android and cross-platform apps
- [Web Development](https://jaltech.org/#web-development): Websites, portals and web applications
- [DevOps & Cloud Solutions](https://jaltech.org/#devops-cloud): Cloud infrastructure, deployments and support
